title: Commission welcomes political agreement on rules enhancing stability and long-term resilience of EU carbon market
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Oct 2026 The European Commission welcomes the provisional political agreement reached by the European Parliament and the Council on a targeted amendment to strengthen the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) of the EU's Emissions Trading System (EU ETS).
